notes.title: Patch Notes 7/8/2022
notes.notes:
Patches made

When releasing a full janitor cart, the players speed is set to normal running speed
When finishing a speedrun, the player is redirected to a designated speedrun end screen
Removed Herobrine

notes.title: Where's My Lunch!? Speedrun Update!!!
notes.notes:
Full list of updates:

Added a new Speedrun Mode that includes a built-in timer and tracks the players best time
Enemies will stay in the janitor cart for 3 seconds after being let go
Updated the Main menu to have a level selector in each save slot
Added subtitles that can be toggled on and off
Changed the sound of the vacuum
Added achievements and a achievement checklist on the pause menu.
Added trees and background terrain the the outdoor level.
Optimized the rendering for better frame rate.
Fixed a bug that would load the player into the wrong spot.
Completely revamped the save system to (hopefully) be way more consistent
Removed herobrine

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1
notes.notes:
- Added a tutorial note that says "Sneak up on the zombie", which will hopefully make the first 10 seconds of gameplay a little more helpful

 - Volume of background music now changes when dialogue is spoken
-  Added in a couple lines of dialogue
 - Removed herobrine
